lines.text: Golden turtles rested upon warm stones.
phraseGroups: Golden turtles rested upon warm stones.

lines.text: In the shallow water, small fish swam.
Green frogs leaped into floating lilies.
phraseGroups: Green frogs leaped into floating lilies.

lines.text: With a sudden splash, a duck dived.
Bright dragonflies buzzed across the reeds.
phraseGroups: Bright dragonflies buzzed across the reeds.

lines.text: As evening arrived, gentle shadows grew.
